page_title: Item:Legendary Bracers of the Fallen Hero

enchantments.tooltip: Strength +13: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Insightful Constitution +6: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Stunning +15: +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Quality Physical Sheltering +8: +8 Quality bonus to Physical Resistance Rating

Adherent of the Mists Set (Legendary): 5 Pieces Equipped:+30 Profane bonus to Physical Resistance Rating+30 Profane bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification+15 Profane bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+15 Profane bonus to Universal Spell Power
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
